methodology_url: The number of labor resources – The number of labor resources is defined as the sum of the number of the population of working age and the number of workers of younger and older age than the working age according to the following formula:  LR = WAPM + WTP, where: LR – labor resources; WAPM – working-age population of working age;  WTP – working teenagers and pensioners. Detail: https://lex.uz/en/docs/3469431

Permanent population - consists of the population permanently residing in a certain locality or territory at the time of registration, including the population permanently registered in this territory but not temporarily residing. Estimate of the size of the permanent population - is calculated on the basis of the last population census, adding to it the number of people born and immigrating to a certain area each year, and subtracting the number of deaths and people who moved from a certain area. Detail: https://lib.stat.uz/uz/features/demografiya-va-mehnat/853-asosiy-demografik-ko-rsatkichlarni-shakllantirish-bo-yicha-uslubiy-nizom-2

methodology_url: Accounting is carried out in accordance with Article 44 of the Law of the Republic of Uzbekistan “On employment of the population”.  The number of persons in need of employment (unemployed) is determined by subtracting from the number of labor resources the number of employed and the number of economically inactive population according to the formula:  U = LR - E - EIP, where: U – unemployed population in need of employment (unemployed); LR – labor resources; E – employed;  EIP – economically inactive population.
